headline.title: The US banned Anthropic’s Fable 5 release, but the numbers don’t seem to care
headline.summary: The US government has ordered Anthropic to halt the release of its Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models due to national security concerns, following reports of vulnerabilities that could allow users to bypass safety measures. In response, cybersecurity experts have expressed concerns about the implications of this decision, highlighting that similar vulnerabilities exist in other AI models.

articles.title: Is the US government’s Anthropic ban accidentally helping the brand?
articles.summary: The US government's ban on Anthropic's latest models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5, due to national security concerns has sparked criticism from cybersecurity researchers who argue that the decision could be detrimental. Anthropic has pointed out that similar vulnerabilities exist in other AI models, raising questions about the broader implications of the ban.

articles.title: A startup claims it broke through a bottleneck that’s holding back LLMs
articles.summary: Miami-based AI startup Subquadratic has announced that it has solved a longstanding mathematical bottleneck affecting large language models. While initial details were sparse and met with skepticism, the company has begun to provide evidence supporting its claims.

articles.title: Billionaire Ambani wants AI in every call, app, and home
articles.summary: Billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Reliance is integrating artificial intelligence into its telecom services, aiming to enhance user experience for over 500 million customers. The initiative seeks to incorporate AI across various applications, calls, and home technologies.

articles.title: The CEO of Allbirds’ new AI biz has a plan, but no employees
articles.summary: The CEO of Allbirds has launched a new AI startup that currently operates without any employees, relying on a significant seed funding round to kickstart its operations. The future direction and plans for the company remain uncertain at this stage.

articles.title: The film about Sam Altman has been dropped by Amazon MGM
articles.summary: Amazon MGM has canceled the film "Artificial," directed by Luca Guadagnino and centered on OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, after a year of development. The film, featuring Andrew Garfield and Monica Barbaro, was set to depict the tumultuous events surrounding Altman's termination and subsequent reinstatement in 2023.

articles.title: The US says ASML’s top chip tool may be in China. ASML says it isn’t.
articles.summary: The U.S. government has raised concerns that ASML's advanced chip manufacturing equipment may be located in China, while ASML has denied these claims. The company asserts that it would not jeopardize its export license by supplying such technology to a Chinese client.

articles.title: Source: Elastic agrees to buy CRV-backed Deductive AI for up to $85M
articles.summary: Elastic has agreed to acquire Deductive AI, a startup focused on using AI to identify and fix software bugs, for up to $85 million. Founded three years ago and backed by CRV, Deductive AI aims to enhance software development processes.

articles.title: AI inference startup Baseten reportedly raising $1.5B months after its last mega-round
articles.summary: AI inference startup Baseten is reportedly nearing the completion of a $1.5 billion funding round, which would value the company at $13 billion. This comes just months after its previous significant funding round amid growing interest in AI inference technologies.

articles.title: Barret Zoph is out at OpenAI again after just five months
articles.summary: Barret Zoph has left OpenAI again after just five months, having rejoined the company in January as head of enterprise AI sales. His departure follows a previous role as co-founder and CTO of Thinking Machines Lab, a competing AI firm.

articles.title: Measuring Curriculum Alignment across Topical Coverage, Competency, and Cognitive Depth: A Longitudinal Framework Applied to CS2013 and CS2023
articles.summary: The article presents a human-in-the-loop pipeline designed to measure the alignment of undergraduate computer science curricula with international guidelines, specifically comparing the CS2013 and CS2023 frameworks. This approach aims to provide a reliable method for assessing how well programs cover these guidelines and how that coverage evolves over time.

articles.title: AI4SE and SE4AI Exploration: A Decade Looking Back and Forward
articles.summary: The article reviews the evolution of artificial intelligence in systems engineering over the past decade, categorizing developments into three phases: foundational, applied, and LLM inflection. It highlights the significant impact of the March 2020 INCOSE INSIGHT special issue on AI and Systems Engineering, which initiated a thriving research community.
